Title: Microsoft Cognitive Services | Bing Visual Search API

Body.Content:
Bing Visual Search API is a new service that delivers intelligent image understanding capabilities from Bing. Build compelling image applications through a simple REST API on the device of your choice using Bing Visual Search.
